units.poolKey: COMBINATION C4: a low rung on a working approach
units.spine: The roads into the town carry plenty of traffic. The town stays poor all the same.

units.poolKey: INCOME MIX: one source carries the town
units.spine: One trade carries the town's money. Everyone's living runs through it, whether or not they work in it.

units.poolKey: TRADE PROFILE: exports and imports both present
units.spine: Everyone here knows what goes out and what comes in. The same carts carry both ways.
Warmholz sells several things outward and leans on no single one of them. The list is wide enough to lose one line and keep the trade standing.
Every season, Warmholz feeds itself with a small margin, coming out a little ahead without much drama.
The town works salt it cannot raise itself. Warmholz buys it in the way other towns grow their own, and that is a settled part of the craft.
